extracted.intended_audience: NSW HSC English Advanced examiners, teachers and students
extracted.subtask_description: Marking guidelines for the 2021 NSW HSC English Advanced Paper 2 (Modules A–C), describing the criteria and band descriptors examiners use to award marks for each question.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explains contribution to a broader textual conversation
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how the two extracts provided contribute to a broader textual conversation between the pair of prescribed texts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks: 17–20: 'Skilfully explains how the two extracts provided contribute to a broader textual conversation between the pair of prescribed texts.' 13–16: 'Effectively explains how the two extracts provided contribute to a broader textual conversation between the pair of prescribed texts.' 9–12: 'Explains how the two extracts provided contribute to a broader textual conversation between the pair of prescribed texts.' 5–8 / 1–4: lower bands described as 'Attempts to describe aspects of the prescribed text(s)' / 'Attempts to compose a response to the question.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Understanding of context, language, form and ideas using textual references
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrates understanding of context, language, form and ideas using textual references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks: 17–20: 'Demonstrates a well-informed understanding of context, language, form and ideas using well‑selected and detailed textual references.' 13–16: 'Demonstrates an informed understanding of context, language, form and ideas using detailed textual references.' 9–12: 'Demonstrates an understanding of context, language, form and ideas using some textual references.' Lower bands: 'Demonstrates some understanding ... with limited textual references' (5–8) and minimal/no demonstration in 1–4.

rubrics_metrics.name: Composes response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form
rubrics_metrics.description: Composes a response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks: 17–20: 'Composes a thoughtful response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.' 13–16: 'Composes an effective response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.' 9–12: 'Composes a sound response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.' Lower bands: 5–8 'Composes a limited response to the question' and 1–4 'Attempts to compose a response to the question.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluates extent of statement's truth of prescribed text
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluates the extent to which the statement is true of their prescribed text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks: 17–20: 'Skilfully evaluates the extent to which the statement is true of their prescribed text.' 13–16: 'Effectively evaluates the extent to which the statement is true of their prescribed text.' 9–12: 'Evaluates the extent to which the statement is true of their prescribed text.' 5–8: 'Responds to some aspects of the statement' / limited evaluation. 1–4: attempts or minimal response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrates understanding of context, language, form and ideas (Module B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrates understanding of the prescribed text's context, language, form and ideas using textual references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks: 17–20: 'Demonstrates a well-informed understanding of context, language, form and ideas using well‑selected and detailed textual references.' 13–16: 'Demonstrates an informed understanding ... using detailed textual references.' 9–12: 'Demonstrates an understanding ... using some textual references.' 5–8: 'Demonstrates some understanding ... with limited textual references.' 1–4: minimal/attempted understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Composes response appropriate to audience, purpose and form (Module B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Composes a response appropriate to audience, purpose and form for the critical study task.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks: 17–20: 'Composes a thoughtful response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.' 13–16: 'Composes an effective response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.' 9–12: 'Composes a sound response using language appropriate to audience, purpose and form.' Lower bands indicate limited or attempted composition (5–8, 1–4).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of stimulus as a central metaphor and engagement (Q3a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Uses the provided stimulus as a central metaphor and composes an engaging piece of writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks (Q3a): 9–10: 'Composes a highly engaging piece of writing that effectively uses the stimulus as a central metaphor.' 7–8: 'Composes an engaging piece of writing that uses the stimulus as a central metaphor.' 5–6: 'Composes a piece of writing that adequately uses the stimulus.' 3–4 / 1–2: limited/attempted relevance to the stimulus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crafts language to compose with a central metaphor (Q3a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Crafts language to create a piece of writing that employs a central metaphor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks (Q3a): 9–10: 'Crafts language skilfully to compose a piece of writing with a central metaphor.' 7–8: 'Crafts language effectively to compose a piece of writing with a central metaphor.' 5–6: 'Uses language competently to compose a piece of writing.' Lower bands: variable/limited control of language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control of language and structure appropriate to audience, purpose, context and form (Q3a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrates control of language and structural choices appropriate to audience, purpose, context and the selected form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks (Q3a): 9–10: 'Demonstrates highly effective control of language and structure appropriate to audience, purpose, context and selected form.' 7–8: 'Demonstrates effective control ...' 5–6: 'Demonstrates sound control ...' Lower bands denote variable or limited control; top band = highly effective control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of creative decisions and textual referencing (Q3b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides an evaluation of the creative decisions made in their piece of writing in part (a), with relevant textual references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks (Q3b): 9–10: 'Provides a considered evaluation of the creative decisions made in their piece of writing in part (a), with relevant textual references.' 7–8: 'Provides an evaluation ... with appropriate textual references.' 5–6: 'Provides an explanation of the creative decisions made in their piece of writing in part (a).' 3–4 / 1–2: describes some features or attempts limited explanation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of how study of figurative language influenced writing (Q3b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how the study of figurative language in The Craft of Writing influenced their writing in part (a), referencing prescribed texts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks (Q3b): 9–10: 'Provides a considered evaluation of how the study of figurative language in The Craft of Writing influenced their writing in part (a), making well‑selected references to one or more prescribed texts.' 7–8: 'Provides an evaluation ... making appropriate references.' 5–6: 'Provides an explanation of their study ... making reference to one or more prescribed texts.' Lower bands: limited reference or attempt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control of language in reflective/explanatory response (Q3b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrates control of language when evaluating/explaining creative decisions and study influences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Band descriptors / marks (Q3b): 9–10: 'Demonstrates skilful control of language.' 7–8: 'Demonstrates effective control of language.' 5–6: 'Demonstrates sound control of language.' Lower bands: 'Demonstrates limited control of language' (3–4) and minimal control/attempts at 1–2.
